title: lycopodium clavatum var. trichophyllum
intro: Lycopodium clavatum var. trichophyllum, commonly known as Ground Pine or Club Moss, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the lycopodiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Ground Pine include soothing and calming the nervous system, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Lycopodium clavatum var. trichophyllum include alkaloids, terpenoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
